_howto: Read the full paper, then inventory every figure, panel, visible series, and table. PhysicsReproductionProject.reproduction_scope freezes the complete theory-numerical scope.
Split mixed experiment/theory panels into figure_series items with parent_item_id.
scientific_role for figure items: theory_numerical | experimental_measurement | experimental_image | schematic_context | context.
Every theory_numerical item id must be frozen in reproduction_scope.target_item_ids and declare reproduction_content=theory_numerical_only; selecting only an easy subset is invalid.

Every generated target must come from independent formula/method numericalization (independent_numerics or analytic_reference); digitized source pixels are reference-only and mixed generated/reference data is forbidden.

A printed numeric table that only supplies model inputs uses scientific_role=source_parameter, decision=excluded, and consumed_by_target_ids; it is audited as provenance and never counted as an independently generated result.
decision for every theory_numerical item: target (with target_ids) | deferred_blocked (with an objective blocker).
decision for experimental measurements/images, schematics, context, and tables: excluded.
Allowed schema-v3 blockers: missing_author_data, missing_benchmark_metadata, missing_source_input, insufficient_compute, requires_external_hardware.
'Supporting', 'low priority', 'similar to another figure', 'covered by another target', and user descope are NOT blockers.
Coverage means scientific reproduction (independent numerics or analytic references). Digitized curves and copied source panels do not count as coverage.
If compute or data is genuinely insufficient, deferred_blocked with an honest reason is the correct final state; do not fake coverage.

acceptance_criteria: T001, T002, T003A and T003B execute the paper-declared multilevel Hamiltonian with 300 Trotter intervals and pass probability, normalization, target-sector and coloring-sector invariants.
T004 fails closed on the published protocol-c parameter conflict instead of selecting values from source graphics or author data.
The runner reads no paper dataset, original figure, author array, author code, raw artifact, reference artifact, or legacy numerical output.
The generated-data manifest freezes scientific arrays before the separate comparison process opens Dataset.zip.

items.reason: Level and control schematic; formulas are audited separately.
Independent k=3 evolution covers A-F curves and E/F final distributions.
Independent k=4 evolution covers G-I final distributions.
Protocol-c Omega values conflict between Appendix A.2 and the Figure-7 caption, so one paper-exact Hamiltonian cannot be frozen.
Independent k=2 appendix evolution is executed and named mismatches remain evidence.
Independent k=3 G-J appendix distributions are executed.
Printed coordinates are frozen model inputs; their geometric consistency is audited, but copying them is not claimed as scientific reproduction.
Printed lattice spacings are frozen model inputs; their distance relations are audited, but the values are not independently generated results.
